greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi. Kristu, ube nenceba kuthi. Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi.
homily:
Kukho umzuzu othi cwaka, umfanekiso onokuthi uwubone ngeso lengqondo: uBenjamin Vo ehlezi ekhaya, ephethe iphepha elincinci okanye ekhangela ikhowudi yekhompyutha yakhe, ebonakala engathi ucinga ngento enkulu kakhulu. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwazi ukuba izinto zisebenza njani—ukusuka kwizindiza ezinkulu eziphaphayo ukuze zithwale abantu, ukuya kwikhowudi yomdlalo awayeyila ngothando. Khumbula loo mfana owayesoloko enoncumo, owayenentliziyo eyayisoloko ikulungele ukunika, nokuba yayiyimbono yakhe yokuqala inkampani, okanye umnqweno wakhe wokunika konke awayenako ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. UBen wayengumntu owayesazi ukuba ubomi, ngaphezu kwako konke, bubudlelwane obunzulu phakathi kwabantu nangoThixo.

Namhlanje, uIsaya oNgcwele usinika amazwi athi: 'Funa iNkosi xa isafumaneka, yibize xa ikufuphi.' La magama asikhumbuza ukuba uThixo akakude. Kodwa ngamanye amaxesha, xa intliziyo yethu ibuhlungu, kusenzima ukuyibona loo kufutshane kweNkosi. Ngamanye amaxesha, sicinga ukuba iindlela zikaThixo kufuneka zifane nezi zethu. Kodwa uThixo uthi: 'Iingcinga zam azizo iingcinga zenu, neendlela zam azizo iindlela zenu.' Oku kunzima ukukwamkela xa siphulukene nomntu esimthandayo.

Masithethe inyaniso. Sekuphele iinyanga ezintathu uBen esishiye. Iinyanga ezintathu zokuziva ukuba indlu ithule kakhulu. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba usizi luyinto enzima, ngakumbi xa ucinga ngaloo mntwana wakho owayekuthanda kakhulu. Usizi aluhambi ngokwekhalenda. Niyazibuza ukuba kwenzeke ntoni. Niyazibuza ukuba kutheni lo mfana owayephila ngothando, owayephila ngobubele, kufuneka ahambe ngolu hlobo. Niyazibuza ukuba kukhona na eninokukwenza ngcono. Ndicela niphulaphule: Ukugula akulona iphutha lenu. Akukho nto eniyenze ngendlela engalunganga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Susa lowo mthwalo wokuzisola egxalabeni lakho. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu usixelela ngomninimzi oqesha abasebenzi kwisidiliya sakhe. Abanye baqala ekuseni, abanye emini, abanye ekupheleni kosuku. Kodwa bonke bafumana umvuzo omnye. Abanye bayakhalaza, besithi: 'Aba bokugqibela basebenze iyure enye kuphela, kwaye ubakhuphe ngokulinganayo nathi.' Kodwa umninimzi uthi: 'Ndingenalo na ilungelo lokwenza endikuthandayo ngemali yam? Ingaba unomona ngokuba ndinomusa?'

Eli lithuba elinzima kakhulu. UYesu usibonisa ukuba inceba kaThixo ayilandeli imithetho yethu yobulungisa. UThixo unika ubomi, kwaye uThixo uthatha ubomi ngendlela yakhe. UBen wayengumfana owayenikela ngayo yonke into yakhe, njengoko wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. UBen wayeyimbewu enothando. Wayengumfana owayephila ngothando, kodwa ngoku, ubomi bakhe busikhumbuza ukuba ubomi bethu abupheleli apha emhlabeni. UBen utyalwe emhlabeni ngendlela yomzimba, kodwa uya kuvuka ngendlela yomoya—ngomzimba oqaqambileyo, onamandla, nowonwabileyo phambi koThixo.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ekukhathalele. Qhubeka uphila ngesibindi, ube ngumfana owayeyiyo—onemfesane, onobubele, nonesibindi. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi eCà Mau, olethela ubomi kwabanye. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lugeza umhlaba njengolwandle olukhulu. Nani, Alan noThao, ningayeki ukuthanda. Nithandeke kakhulu nguThixo. UBen wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Nani, nikani konke usizi lwenu kuThixo. Musani ukuzama ukuluthwala lodwa. Vumelani uYesu ukuba abe lulwalwa lwenu.

Xa uziva usizi, yithi: 'Nkosi, ndiyakuthanda, kwaye ndiyakuthemba.' UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Uthando lwakho, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi, luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye luyaqhubeka lukhanyisa iindlela zethu. Khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo, kwaye nathi, simele siphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kule Sakramente eNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku ngokwasemzimbeni, nceda uze kum ngomoya entliziyweni yam. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ukhona, ndimanyane nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ukuba ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: INkosi mayikusikelele, ikugcine, kwaye ikunike uxolo lwayo olungapheliyo.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyisweni lukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abasemlilweni wosizi, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba eliqinileyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Funa iNkosi xa isafumaneka, yibize xa ikufuphi. Makayiyeke umoni indlela yakhe, nomoni iingcinga zakhe; makabuyele eNkosini ukuze afumane inceba; kuThixo wethu, onobubele ekuxoleleni. Kuba iingcinga zam azizo iingcinga zenu, neendlela zam azizo iindlela zenu, itsho iNkosi. Njengoko amazulu ephakamile phezu komhlaba, iindlela zam ziphakamile phezu kweendlela zenu, neengcinga zam phezu kweengcinga zenu.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. INkosi ikufuphi kubo bonke abayibizayo. Yonke imihla ndiya kukubonga, ndiya kulidumisa igama lakho ngonaphakade. Inkulu iNkosi, ifanele ukudunyiswa kakhulu; ubukhulu bayo abunakufundwa. R. INkosi ikufuphi kubo bonke abayibizayo. INkosi inobubele nenceba, iyazeka kancinci kwaye inomusa omkhulu. INkosi ilungile kubo bonke, inemfesane kuyo yonke imisebenzi yayo. R. INkosi ikufuphi kubo bonke abayibizayo. INkosi ilungile ezindleleni zayo zonke, ingcwele kuyo yonke imisebenzi yayo. INkosi ikufuphi kubo bonke abayibizayo, kubo bonke abayibiza ngenyaniso. R. INkosi ikufuphi kubo bonke abayibizayo.

readings.label: Isifundo sesibini
readings.text: Bazalwana noodade bethu: UKristu uya kukhuliswa emzimbeni wam, nokuba kusebomini okanye kusekufeni. Kuba kum, ubomi nguKristu, ukufa kuzuza. Ukuba ndiyaqhubeka ndiphila emzimbeni, oko kuthetha umsebenzi ovelisayo kum. Andazi ukuba ndiya kukhetha ntoni. Ndiphakathi kwezimbini. Ndiyaqhubeka ndinqwenela ukumka ndibe noKristu, kuba oko kungcono kakhulu. Kodwa ukuhlala kwam emzimbeni kuyimfuneko ngakumbi ngenxa yenu. Noko ke, ziphathani ngendlela efanele iVangeli kaKristu.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe lo mzekeliso: 'Ubukumkani bamazulu bufana nomninimzi owaphuma ekuseni ukuya kuqesha abasebenzi besidiliya sakhe. Emva kokuvumelana nabo ngomvuzo wemihla ngemihla, wabathumela esidiliyeni sakhe. Ephuma malunga neyure yesithoba, umninimzi wabona abanye bemi bengasebenzi endle, wathi kubo, "Nani hamba niye esidiliyeni sam, ndiya kuninika okufanelekileyo." Bahamba ke. Waphuma kwakhona malunga nemini, nangeyeure yesithathu, wenza okufanayo. Ephuma malunga neyure yesihlanu, umninimzi wafumana abanye bemi, wathi kubo, "Kutheni nimi apha imini yonke ningasebenzi?" Baphendula bathi, "Kuba akukho mntu usiqeshileyo." Wathi kubo, "Nani hamba niye esidiliyeni sam." Xa kuhlwe, umninimzi wathi kumphathi wakhe, "Biza abasebenzi ubanike umvuzo wabo, uqale ngabokugqibela uze uphele ngabokuqala." Xa kwafika abo baqale malunga neyure yesihlanu, ngamnye wafumana umvuzo wemihla ngemihla. Xa kwafika abokuqala, bacinga ukuba baya kufumana ngaphezulu, kodwa ngamnye wafumana umvuzo ofanayo. Xa bewufumana, bakhalaza kumninimzi besithi, "Aba bokugqibela basebenze iyure enye kuphela, kwaye ubakhuphe ngokulinganayo nathi, thina esithwale umthwalo wemini nokushisa." Waphendula wathi komnye wabo, "Mhlobo wam, andikukhohlisi. Asivumelani na ngomvuzo wemihla ngemihla? Thatha okungokwakho uhambe. Kutheni ukuba ndinqwenela ukunika lo wokugqibela okufanayo nawe? Andinalo na ilungelo lokwenza endikuthandayo ngemali yam? Unomona na ngokuba ndinomusa?" Ngaloo ndlela, abokugqibela baya kuba ngabokuqala, nabokuqala baya kuba ngabokugqibela.'

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
